en.headline: MTR begins autonomous vehicle road tests linking West Kowloon and Kowloon stations
en.dek: Four Baidu Apollo sixth-generation cars started non-passenger trials on Wednesday along a designated route; a transfer service is targeted for the second quarter of 2027.
body: The MTR Corporation on Wednesday began road testing of autonomous vehicles between Hong Kong West Kowloon Station of the Express Rail Link and Kowloon Station of the Airport Express.

Four sixth-generation Baidu Apollo private cars are operating along a fixed route that includes Wui Man Road, Jordan Road, Nga Cheung Road and the station perimeter roads. In the initial phase the vehicles carry no passengers; a backup operator remains on board at all times to monitor systems and take manual control if required.

MTR said the eventual service would give travellers an additional option for transferring between high-speed rail and the Airport Express, complementing the existing walk through ELEMENTS. Subject to Transport Department approval, testing will progress to driverless passenger trials. The operator aims to launch the service in the second quarter of 2027 and will announce further operational details later.

zh.headline: 港鐵西九龍展開自動車路面測試 目標明年第二季提供接駁服務
zh.dek: 四輛百度Apollo第六代自動私家車周三起在指定路段測試，初期不載客，後備操作員全程隨車；擬明年第二季推出高鐵與機場快綫接駁服務。
body: 港鐵公司周三起在西九龍地區展開自動駕駛車輛路面測試，往來高鐵香港西九龍站與機場快綫九龍站。
項目獲運輸署發出先導牌照後，港鐵安排四輛百度Apollo第六代自動私家車在指定路段行駛，途經匯民道、佐敦道、雅翔道及車站環迴路等。首階段不載客，承辦商安排後備操作員全程隨車監察，有需要時可即時介入。
港鐵表示，服務將為高鐵與航空旅客提供額外轉乘選擇，促進鐵空聯運。取得運輸署批准後，會逐步推展至無人駕駛載客測試，目標明年第二季推出服務，詳情稍後公布。
